messages:
Carla: FYI canary of cu12 images pushed to image-buildpool in eu-west/ap-southeast is triggering provisioner hangs and NCCL hangs on V100 nodes. First seen ~02:12 UTC. deploy-bot reported a ton of OOM+CrashLoopBackOffs.

deploy-bot: [autodeploy] canary-build 2026-05-03T02:12:18Z - image push succeeded
ops-bot: provisioner: scale-up failed: timeout attaching device on n0123
Jay: logs? paste the pod describe and kubelet output
Carla: here's the common tail (reduced):
```
stderr: /opt/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so.12: undefined symbol: _ZN6c10__something
Warning: ld.so: object 'libstdc++.so.6' from container rpath is incompatible
```
Mukesh: that "undefined symbol" + libstdc++ warning screams mixed-toolchain -> container rebuilt with gcc13 toolchain against cu12, host drivers match cu12 but kernel module expects older abi.
Li: Also seeing NCCL: "unhandled cuda error" and NVLink setup failures in kernel logs on affected nodes.
Anita: How many nodes? Can we cordon eu-west nodes and force rollback to cu11 images?
Carla: ~18 nodes affected across two AZs, autoscaler thrashed and used ~120 GPU-hours in retries. Cost spike estimate ~ $6k for the window.
Sam: Suggested quick mitigation: 1) pause canary, 2) cordon and drain affected nodes, 3) revert image tag to cu11-canary, 4) avoid node reprovision until we confirm toolchain matching.
Jay: +1. Who can own revert? @mukesh can you coordinate with CI to pin gcc toolchain in image build?
Mukesh: On it. Rolling a hotfix tag now that pins libstdc++ and forces glibc compat. ETA 35m. Will also patch provisioner to skip draining bound GPU pods.
Carla: I'll open an incident and add the cost numbers and timeline. Also adding a checklist for packaging: ensure runtime-lib audit and nvcc/toolkit version matrix in build pipeline.
Anita: For long term we need automated canary validation that runs quick nccl allreduce smoke on each image before allowing cluster rollout.
Carla: Agreed. Action items:
- Mukesh: hotfix image and CI enforcement (owner)
- Jay: improve provisioner timeouts + better error surfacing
- Sam: cost writeup + alert thresholds for autoscaler churn
- Li: kernel logs dump + node ripgrep scripts for postmortem
Carla: tagging people for follow-up @mukesh @jay @sam :eyes: 
Sam: thanks, will track in incident channel and update billing
deploy-bot: [rollback] image-tag cu11-stable deployed to node pool 'buildpool-canary' at 02:56 UTC
Carla: rollback complete, most pods stable now. We'll keep canary paused until CI verification lands.
Li: nodes show stable nvlink init now, NCCL errors dropped. Closing loop on immediate issue.
